text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Mejiro McQueen—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, look, Trainer. What an adorable 
plushie.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Mejiro McQueen's gaze, I saw 
plushies modeled after Umamusume displayed 
as crane game prizes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen must really like the 
plushie, as she's staring intently at 
it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
N-No, it's not that. I was just a little 
curious...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, this game looks quite difficult. 
I doubt I could ever win that plushie."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Trainer-san is...? A-Are you sure 
about that!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
